background: Santander UK is the British ring-fenced bank of Banco Santander, funded by UK retail and business deposits and lending mainly on residential mortgages and to UK companies, and the owner of TSB.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all on a stable outlook after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is in line with UK majors, CET1 of 14.0% just above the peer median and leverage of 4.8% just below it. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 175% and NSFR of 137% both in the top quarter. Nothing has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
